vue-components.name: Dialog
vue-components.description: Headless, accessible modal dialog on the native `<dialog>` element + `showModal()` — top-layer rendering, a native `::backdrop` scrim, a real focus trap, Escape-to-dismiss, and a two-way `open` binding with a typed `close` event.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown (two-way `r-model`). The sole `model: true` prop — two-way bind it (`r-model:open` / `v-model:open` / `bind:open` / `[(open)]`) and Dialog reconciles the native `<dialog>` to it via `showModal()` / `close()`. Every close path (backdrop, Escape, programmatic `hide()`) writes `open = false` and emits `close`.

props.name: disable-backdrop-close
props.description: Opt **out** of backdrop-click-to-dismiss. By default a click on the scrim (the `<dialog>` element itself, outside the content panel) closes the dialog with `reason: 'backdrop'`; set this to require an explicit action.

props.name: disable-escape-close
props.description: Opt **out** of Escape-to-dismiss. By default the native `cancel` event (Esc) closes with `reason: 'escape'`; the component `preventDefault()`s it so the close always flows through the `open` model. Set this to keep the dialog open on Escape (e.g. a required confirmation).

props.name: disable-scroll-lock
props.description: Opt **out** of locking `<html>` scroll while the dialog is open. By default `document.documentElement` `overflow` is set to `hidden` for the duration the dialog is shown; set this to leave background scrolling enabled.

props.name: initial-focus
props.description: What to focus when the dialog opens: a CSS selector matched inside the dialog content, or an Element. By default the native `showModal()` choice applies: the first element with `autofocus`, otherwise the first focusable element. Use it to start on a specific field (e.g. `initialFocus="input[name=title]"`) without waiting for the dialog to mount. A selector that matches nothing, or an element that is not focusable, leaves the native choice in place.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the dialog (`aria-label`) when there is no visible title to point at. Prefer `ariaLabelledby` when a visible heading exists.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The `id` of the element that titles the dialog (`aria-labelledby`) — preferred over `ariaLabel` when a visible heading exists inside the dialog. On the Lit element the dialog lives in a shadow root while the heading is slotted light DOM, so the attribute alone cannot reach it; Dialog hands the browser the element directly (`ariaLabelledByElements`) where that is supported (Chrome/Edge 135+, Safari 16.4+) — elsewhere, use `ariaLabel` on Lit.

events.name: close
events.description: Fired whenever the dialog dismisses — through a backdrop click, the Escape key, a programmatic `hide()`, or a native close that did not go through the component (such as a `<form method="dialog">` submit). Payload `{ reason }` where `reason` is `'backdrop'`, `'escape'`, or `'programmatic'` (the last covers `hide()` and any native close). The two-way `open` model is set to `false` on the same tick, so you usually only need this to learn *why* it closed (e.g. to skip a confirmation on an explicit Cancel).

events.name: update:open
events.description: Emitted with the updated `open` value; powers `v-model:open`.
